title: HtmlElement
responsibility: Renders the native element selected by its this property without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlElement.attributes
inputs.description: Native selected-element attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlElement.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native selected element; native HTML content rules still apply.

inputs.name: HtmlElement.this
inputs.description: Native element tag selected by the caller; the direct component defaults to div.

outputs.name: HtmlElement
outputs.description: The actual native selected element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
